name: lose_route
description: Hold the back row for three turns, then on turn 4 (enemy strikes first) step up-right into range of both enemies: the lane-2 enemy shoots first (HP 4 -> 1), the player hits the lane-4 enemy (4 -> 1), and the lane-4 enemy's arrow finishes the player.
target_format: [col, lane] zero-based, or null = hold fire / no target
expected_reason: shot by the enemy archer in lane 4
